source.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀אִ֣ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֧א מִיהוּדָ֛ה בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְיָרָבְעָ֛ם עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לְהַקְטִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, [a] man of God came from Judah by [the] word of Yahweh to Bethel, and Jeroboam [was] standing by the altar to make smoke.

en.L: And look, a man of God came from Judah by [the] word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to Bethel, while Jeroboam [was] standing by the altar to burn incense.
en.B: Just then a man of God came from Judah to Bethel by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, while Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.
en.R: Just then a man of God came from Judah to Bethel. He came at {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s command. Jeroboam was standing by the altar, ready to burn incense.

es.L: Y he aquí que un hombre de Dios vino de Judá por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Betel, mientras Jeroboam [estaba] de pie junto al altar para quemar incienso.
es.B: En ese momento llegó a Betel un hombre de Dios, que venía de Judá por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, mientras Jeroboam estaba de pie junto al altar para quemar incienso.
es.R: En ese momento llegó a Betel un hombre de Dios que venía de Judá. Venía por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Jeroboam estaba de pie junto al altar, listo para quemar incienso.

fr.L: Et voici, un homme de Dieu vint de Juda, par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, à Béthel, tandis que Jéroboam [se] tenait près de l’autel pour brûler de l’encens.
fr.B: À ce moment, un homme de Dieu vint de Juda à Béthel par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tandis que Jéroboam se tenait près de l’autel pour brûler de l’encens.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, un homme de Dieu est arrivé de Juda à Béthel. Il venait sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Jéroboam se tenait près de l’autel, prêt à brûler de l’encens.

sw.L: Na tazama, mtu wa Mungu alikuja kutoka Yuda kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mpaka Betheli, naye Yeroboamu [alikuwa] amesimama karibu na madhabahu ili kufukiza uvumba.
sw.B: Wakati huo huo mtu wa Mungu alifika Betheli kutoka Yuda kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Yeroboamu akiwa amesimama karibu na madhabahu ili kufukiza uvumba.
sw.R: Wakati huo huo mtu wa Mungu alikuja Betheli kutoka Yuda. Alikuja kwa amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yeroboamu alikuwa amesimama karibu na madhabahu, tayari kufukiza uvumba.

vi.L: Kìa, có một người của Đức Chúa Trời từ Giu-đa đến Bê-tên theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong khi Giê-rô-bô-am đang đứng bên bàn thờ để đốt hương.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, có một người của Đức Chúa Trời từ Giu-đa đến Bê-tên theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trong khi Giê-rô-bô-am đang đứng bên bàn thờ để đốt hương.
vi.R: Ngay lúc ấy, có một người của Đức Chúa Trời từ Giu-đa đến Bê-tên. Ông đến theo lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Giê-rô-bô-am đang đứng bên bàn thờ, sắp đốt hương.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 유다에서 벧엘로 왔다. 그때 여로보암은 분향하려고 제단 곁에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 바로 그때 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 받고 유다에서 벧엘로 왔다. 그때 여로보암은 분향하려고 제단 곁에 서 있었다.
ko.R: 바로 그때 하나님의 사람 하나가 유다에서 벧엘로 왔다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 받고 온 것이었다. 여로보암은 분향하려고 제단 곁에 서 있었다.

pt.L: E eis que um homem de Deus veio de Judá pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a Betel, enquanto Jeroboão [estava] de pé junto ao altar para queimar incenso.
pt.B: Naquele momento, um homem de Deus chegou de Judá a Betel pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, enquanto Jeroboão estava de pé junto ao altar para queimar incenso.
pt.R: Naquele momento, um homem de Deus chegou de Judá a Betel. Ele veio por ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Jeroboão estava de pé junto ao altar, pronto para queimar incenso.

am.L: እነሆም፣ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቃል ከይሁዳ ወደ ቤቴል መጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ዕጣን ለማጠን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ልኮት ከይሁዳ ወደ ቤቴል መጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ዕጣን ለማጠን በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ከይሁዳ ወደ ቤቴል መጣ። የመጣውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስላዘዘው ነበር። ኢዮርብዓም ዕጣን ለማጠን ተዘጋጅቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

hi.L: और देखो, परमेश्वर का एक जन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से यहूदा से बेतेल को आया, और यारोबाम धूप जलाने के लिए वेदी के पास खड़ा [था]।
hi.B: ठीक उसी समय परमेश्वर का एक जन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से यहूदा से बेतेल आया, जब यारोबाम धूप जलाने के लिए वेदी के पास खड़ा था।
hi.R: ठीक उसी समय परमेश्वर का एक जन यहूदा से बेतेल आया। वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञा से आया था। यारोबाम धूप जलाने के लिए वेदी के पास खड़ा था।

ru.L: И вот, человек Божий пришёл из Иуды по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} в Вефиль, а Иеровоам стоял у жертвенника, чтобы воскурить благовония.
ru.B: В это самое время человек Божий по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} пришёл из Иуды в Вефиль, когда Иеровоам стоял у жертвенника, чтобы воскурить благовония.
ru.R: В это самое время человек Божий пришёл из Иуды в Вефиль. Он пришёл по повелению {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Иеровоам стоял у жертвенника и собирался сжечь благовония.

ja.L: するとなんと、神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によってユダからベテルに来た。ヤロブアムは香をたくために祭壇のそばに立っていた。
ja.B: ちょうどそのとき、神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によってユダからベテルに来た。ヤロブアムは香をたくために祭壇のそばに立っていた。
ja.R: ちょうどそのとき、一人の神の人が、ユダからベテルにやって来ました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に命じられて来たのです。ヤロブアムは、香をたこうとして、祭壇のそばに立っていました。

uk.L: І ось чоловік Божий прийшов з Юдеї за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до Бетеля, а Єровоам [саме] стояв біля жертовника, щоб кадити.
uk.B: Саме тоді за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} з Юдеї до Бетеля прийшов чоловік Божий, коли Єровоам стояв біля жертовника, щоб спалити кадило.
uk.R: Саме тоді з Юдеї до Бетеля прийшов чоловік Божий. Він прийшов за наказом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Єровоам стояв біля жертовника, готовий спалити кадило.

decisions.choice: a man of God: a prophet, here not named
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks for God (1 Samuel 2:27; 9:6). This one is never named. In this chapter he is called "the man of God" throughout, while the man from Bethel in verse 11 is called "the prophet".

decisions.choice: by the word of the LORD: sent by Yahweh's command and acting on it
decisions.reason: The phrase runs through the whole chapter (verses 1, 2, 5, 9, 17, 18, 32). The man of God comes, speaks and is given his instructions by Yahweh's word, and the story turns on whether he will keep to that word when another voice claims it too.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam at his altar: the feast he set up at Bethel (12:32-33)
decisions.reason: Jeroboam had built an altar at Bethel and made a feast of his own choosing in the eighth month, going up to the altar himself to burn offerings (12:32-33). The man of God arrives at that very moment.

decisions.choice: to burn incense, or to make offerings go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb means to send something up in smoke on an altar. It is used of incense and also of the fat of sacrifices. Either fits here.

decisions.choice: by the word of the LORD (Literal, Balanced); at the LORD's command (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept the same every time it comes back in this chapter, so the reader can follow it. Readable says "at the LORD's command" each time, which is the sense in plain words.

decisions.choice: Just then
decisions.reason: "Look" draws attention to a sudden arrival. Balanced and Readable say "Just then".

decisions.choice: "por la palabra del SEÑOR" (L, B); "por orden del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase recurs through the chapter; each level keeps one wording, as the English does with "by the word of" and "at the LORD's command".

decisions.choice: "par la parole du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "sur l’ordre du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording each time the phrase returns in this chapter, as the English keeps it, so that the reader can follow it.

decisions.choice: kwa neno la BWANA (Literal, Balanced); kwa amri ya BWANA (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase recurs through the chapter; each level keeps its one wording, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mtu wa Mungu
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is kept as "mtu wa Mungu" at every level, as the terms note sets; the meaning decision says he is a prophet.

decisions.choice: o homem de Deus (every level); o profeta for the man of Bethel (verse 11)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "homem de Deus" is the prophet's title (m1), as 1 Samuel 2:27 and 9:6 have it in Portuguese, kept at every level and through this chapter for the man from Judah, while the man of Bethel is "o profeta" (verse 11), so that the reader can tell the two apart as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: pela palavra do SENHOR (L, B); por ordem do SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter (verses 1, 2, 5, 9, 17, 18, 32): the phrase the story turns on (m2) keeps one wording at each level, as the English does: "pela palavra" at Literal and Balanced, the plain "por ordem" at Readable. "Segundo a palavra" is kept for the different phrase of verse 26. Where the man of God reports the command (verses 9, 17), Readable says "o SENHOR me deu esta ordem", since "recebi esta ordem por ordem" would repeat the word.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of 1 Kings 13
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (verses 9, 22 and 26).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቃል" (Literal); "... ቃል ልኮት" (Balanced); "... ስላዘዘው" (Readable), through the chapter
decisions.reason: The phrase recurs through the story (verses 1, 2, 5, 9, 17, 18, 32) and keeps one wording at each level; Amharic "በ...ቃል" reads as "by the command of".

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर का जन"
decisions.reason: A prophet, here not named (meaning m1); the history-books note's form at every level, as 1 Samuel 2:27 and 9:6 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से" (L, B); "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञा से" (R)
decisions.reason: Sent by Yahweh's command and acting on it (meaning m2); Readable says command, as the English does, through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "देखो" (L); "ठीक उसी समय" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew particle; Balanced and Readable say "just then", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "по слову ГОСПОДА" (L, B); "по повелению ГОСПОДА" (R)
decisions.reason: Sent by the LORD's command and acting on it (m2); the phrase recurs through the chapter, and each level keeps its wording.

decisions.choice: "человек Божий"
decisions.reason: As the history terms note sets.

decisions.choice: vehinneh "するとなんと" (L), "ちょうどそのとき" (B, R); ish elohim "神の人"; bidvar YHWH "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によって" (L, B), "…に命じられて" (R)
decisions.reason: hinneh in narration as GEN-consistency (Literal; なんと / するとなんと, no 見よ, as 2SA-consistency); man of God as 1SA 2:27. "By the word of the LORD" runs through the chapter (13:2, 5, 9, 17, 18, 32) and keeps these forms.

decisions.choice: "чоловік Божий" for the man of God at every level, through Kings
decisions.reason: The set phrase for a prophet; the word order with the adjective after the noun marks it as a title.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מִזְבֵּ֣חַ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּֽה־בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֤ד לְבֵית־דָּוִד֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ שְׁמ֔וֹ וְזָבַ֣ח עָלֶ֗יךָ אֶת־כֹּהֲנֵ֤י הַבָּמוֹת֙ הַמַּקְטִרִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ וְעַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he called out against the altar by [the] word of Yahweh and said, Altar, altar, thus says Yahweh: look, a son [will be] born to [the] house of David, Josiah [is] his name, and he will sacrifice on you the priests of the high places who make smoke on you, and bones of man they will burn on you.

en.L: And he called out against the altar by [the] word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "Altar, altar, thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'Look, a son will be born to the house of David, Josiah [is] his name; and he will sacrifice on you the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and human bones they will burn on you.'"
en.B: By the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} he cried out against the altar, "Altar, altar! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'A son will be born to the house of David, and his name will be Josiah. He will sacrifice on you the priests of the high places who burn their incense here, and human bones will be burned on you.'"
en.R: At {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s command, he shouted at the altar, "Altar, altar! This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: 'One day David's family will have a son named Josiah. He will kill the priests of the hilltop shrines who burn incense on you, and offer them on you as sacrifices. Human bones will be burned on you.'"

es.L: Y clamó contra el altar por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y dijo: «Altar, altar, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “He aquí que a la casa de David le nacerá un hijo, Josías [será] su nombre; y sacrificará sobre ti a los sacerdotes de los lugares altos que queman incienso sobre ti, y huesos humanos quemarán sobre ti”».
es.B: Por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} clamó contra el altar: «¡Altar, altar! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: “A la casa de David le nacerá un hijo, y su nombre será Josías. Él sacrificará sobre ti a los sacerdotes de los lugares altos que queman aquí su incienso, y sobre ti se quemarán huesos humanos”».
es.R: Por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le gritó al altar: «¡Altar, altar! Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Un día, en la familia de David nacerá un hijo llamado Josías. Él matará a los sacerdotes de los santuarios sobre las colinas que queman incienso sobre ti, y los ofrecerá sobre ti como sacrificios. Sobre ti se quemarán huesos humanos”».

fr.L: Et il cria contre l’autel, par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et dit : « Autel, autel, ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Voici, un fils naîtra à la maison de David, Josias [est] son nom ; et il sacrifiera sur toi les prêtres des hauts lieux qui brûlent de l’encens sur toi, et on brûlera sur toi des ossements humains.” »
fr.B: Par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il cria contre l’autel : « Autel, autel ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : “Un fils naîtra dans la maison de David, et son nom sera Josias. Il sacrifiera sur toi les prêtres des hauts lieux qui brûlent ici leur encens, et des ossements humains seront brûlés sur toi.” »
fr.R: Sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il a crié contre l’autel : « Autel, autel ! Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Un jour, la famille de David aura un fils qui s’appellera Josias. Il tuera les prêtres des sanctuaires sur les collines qui brûlent de l’encens sur toi, et il te les offrira en sacrifice. On brûlera sur toi des ossements humains.” »

sw.L: Akaililia madhabahu kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Madhabahu, madhabahu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: 'Tazama, mwana atazaliwa kwa nyumba ya Daudi, Yosia [ndilo] jina lake; naye atawachinja juu yako makuhani wa mahali pa juu wanaofukiza uvumba juu yako, na mifupa ya wanadamu wataiteketeza juu yako.'"
sw.B: Kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akapaza sauti dhidi ya madhabahu, "Madhabahu, madhabahu! Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: 'Mwana atazaliwa katika nyumba ya Daudi, naye ataitwa Yosia. Atawatoa juu yako kama dhabihu makuhani wa mahali pa juu wanaofukiza uvumba hapa, na mifupa ya wanadamu itateketezwa juu yako.'"
sw.R: Kwa amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaipigia kelele madhabahu, "Madhabahu, madhabahu! Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: 'Siku moja jamaa ya Daudi itapata mwana aitwaye Yosia. Atawaua makuhani wa patakatifu pa kilimani wanaofukiza uvumba juu yako, na kuwatoa juu yako kama dhabihu. Mifupa ya wanadamu itateketezwa juu yako.'"

vi.L: Theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ông kêu lớn nghịch cùng bàn thờ và nói: "Hỡi bàn thờ, bàn thờ! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Kìa, một người con trai sẽ sinh ra cho nhà Đa-vít, tên [là] Giô-si-a; người sẽ dâng trên ngươi các thầy tế lễ của các nơi cao là những kẻ đốt hương trên ngươi, và người ta sẽ đốt xương người trên ngươi.'"
vi.B: Theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ông lớn tiếng kêu nghịch cùng bàn thờ: "Hỡi bàn thờ, bàn thờ! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: 'Nhà Đa-vít sẽ sinh một con trai tên là Giô-si-a. Người sẽ dâng làm sinh tế trên ngươi các thầy tế lễ của các nơi cao, là những kẻ đốt hương tại đây, và xương người sẽ bị đốt trên ngươi.'"
vi.R: Theo lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ông kêu lớn với bàn thờ: "Hỡi bàn thờ, bàn thờ! Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Một ngày kia, dòng dõi Đa-vít sẽ có một con trai tên là Giô-si-a. Người ấy sẽ giết các thầy tế lễ của các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao, là những kẻ đốt hương trên ngươi, và dâng họ làm sinh tế trên ngươi. Xương người ta sẽ bị đốt trên ngươi.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 제단을 향해 외쳐 말했다. "제단아, 제단아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. '보아라, 다윗의 집에 한 아들이 태어날 것이니, 그의 이름은 요시야[이다]. 그가 네 위에서 분향하는 산당 제사장들을 네 위에서 제물로 바칠 것이고, 사람의 뼈를 네 위에서 태울 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 제단을 향해 외쳤다. "제단아, 제단아! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. '다윗의 집안에 한 아들이 태어날 것인데, 그의 이름은 요시야일 것이다. 그가 네 위에서 분향하는 산당 제사장들을 네 위에서 제물로 바칠 것이고, 사람의 뼈가 네 위에서 태워질 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 받고 제단을 향해 소리쳤다. "제단아, 제단아! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. '언젠가 다윗의 집안에 요시야라는 아들이 태어날 것이다. 그는 네 위에서 분향하는 산꼭대기 제단의 제사장들을 죽여서 네 위에 제물로 바칠 것이다. 사람의 뼈가 네 위에서 태워질 것이다.'"

pt.L: E ele clamou contra o altar pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: "Altar, altar, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Eis que um filho nascerá à casa de Davi, Josias [será] o seu nome; e ele sacrificará sobre ti os sacerdotes dos altos que queimam incenso sobre ti, e ossos humanos queimarão sobre ti.'"
pt.B: Pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele clamou contra o altar: "Altar, altar! Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Nascerá um filho à casa de Davi, e o seu nome será Josias. Ele sacrificará sobre ti os sacerdotes dos altos que aqui queimam o seu incenso, e ossos humanos serão queimados sobre ti.'"
pt.R: Por ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele gritou contra o altar: "Altar, altar! É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: 'Um dia a família de Davi vai ter um filho chamado Josias. Ele vai matar os sacerdotes dos santuários no alto dos morros, que queimam incenso sobre ti, e vai oferecê-los sobre ti como sacrifícios. Ossos humanos serão queimados sobre ti.'"

am.L: {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቃልም በመሠዊያው ላይ ጮኸ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «መሠዊያ ሆይ፣ መሠዊያ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ “እነሆ፣ ለዳዊት ቤት ልጅ ይወለዳል፤ ስሙም ኢዮስያስ [ነው]፤ እርሱም በአንተ ላይ ዕጣን የሚያጥኑትን የኮረብታ መስገጃዎች ካህናት በአንተ ላይ ይሠዋል፤ የሰውም አጥንት በአንተ ላይ ያቃጥላሉ።”»
am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል እንዳዘዘውም በመሠዊያው ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ፦ «መሠዊያ ሆይ፣ መሠዊያ ሆይ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ “ለዳዊት ቤት ልጅ ይወለዳል፤ ስሙም ኢዮስያስ ይባላል። እርሱም በዚህ ዕጣን የሚያጥኑትን የኮረብታ መስገጃዎች ካህናት በአንተ ላይ ይሠዋቸዋል፤ የሰውም አጥንት በአንተ ላይ ይቃጠላል።”»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘውም በመሠዊያው ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ፦ «መሠዊያ ሆይ፣ መሠዊያ ሆይ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚለው ይህ ነው፦ “አንድ ቀን ከዳዊት ቤተሰብ ኢዮስያስ የሚባል ልጅ ይወለዳል። እርሱም በአንተ ላይ ዕጣን የሚያጥኑትን የኮረብታ መስገጃዎች ካህናት ይገድላል፤ በአንተም ላይ መሥዋዕት አድርጎ ያቀርባቸዋል። የሰውም አጥንት በአንተ ላይ ይቃጠላል።”»

hi.L: और उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से वेदी के विरुद्ध पुकारकर कहा, "हे वेदी, हे वेदी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: 'देख, दाऊद के घराने में एक पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा, योशिय्याह उसका नाम [होगा]; और वह ऊँचे स्थानों के उन याजकों को जो तुझ पर धूप जलाते हैं, तुझ पर बलि करेगा, और मनुष्यों की हड्डियाँ तुझ पर जलाई जाएँगी।'"
hi.B: उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से वेदी के विरुद्ध पुकारकर कहा, "हे वेदी, हे वेदी! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: 'दाऊद के घराने में एक पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा, जिसका नाम योशिय्याह होगा। वह ऊँचे स्थानों के उन याजकों को, जो यहाँ धूप जलाते हैं, तुझ पर बलि करेगा, और मनुष्यों की हड्डियाँ तुझ पर जलाई जाएँगी।'"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञा से उसने वेदी के विरुद्ध चिल्लाकर कहा, "हे वेदी, हे वेदी! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: 'एक दिन दाऊद के परिवार में योशिय्याह नाम का एक पुत्र जन्म लेगा। ऊँचे स्थानों के जो याजक तुझ पर धूप जलाते हैं, वह उन्हें मार डालेगा और तुझ पर उनकी बलि चढ़ाएगा। तुझ पर मनुष्यों की हड्डियाँ जलाई जाएँगी।'"

ru.L: И он воскликнул против жертвенника по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и сказал: «Жертвенник, жертвенник! Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: “Вот, родится сын у дома Давида, Иосия — имя его, и он принесёт в жертву на тебе священников высот, которые воскуряют на тебе, и человеческие кости сожгут на тебе.”»
ru.B: По слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} он воскликнул против жертвенника: «Жертвенник, жертвенник! Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: “У дома Давида родится сын, и имя ему будет Иосия. Он принесёт в жертву на тебе священников святилищ на холмах, которые воскуряют здесь свои благовония, и на тебе будут сожжены человеческие кости.”»
ru.R: По повелению {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} он закричал, обращаясь к жертвеннику: «Жертвенник, жертвенник! Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: “Однажды в семье Давида родится сын по имени Иосия. Он убьёт священников святилищ на холмах, которые сжигают на тебе благовония, и принесёт их в жертву на тебе. На тебе будут сожжены человеческие кости.”»

ja.L: そして彼は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によって祭壇に向かって呼ばわり、言った。「祭壇よ、祭壇よ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。『見なさい、ダビデの家に一人の子が生まれる。その名はヨシヤ。彼は、おまえの上で香をたく高き所の祭司たちを、おまえの上でいけにえとしてささげ、人の骨がおまえの上で焼かれる。』」
ja.B: 彼は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によって祭壇に向かって叫んだ。「祭壇よ、祭壇よ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。『ダビデの家に一人の男の子が生まれる。その名はヨシヤである。彼は、ここで香をたいている高き所の祭司たちを、おまえの上でいけにえとしてささげ、人の骨がおまえの上で焼かれる。』」
ja.R: その人は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に命じられたとおり、祭壇に向かって叫びました。「祭壇よ、祭壇よ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。『いつか、ダビデの家族に、ヨシヤという名前の男の子が生まれる。ヨシヤは、おまえの上で香をたいている丘の上の礼拝所の祭司たちを殺し、おまえの上でいけにえとしてささげる。人の骨がおまえの上で焼かれる。』」

uk.L: І закликав він проти жертовника за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і сказав: «Жертовнику, жертовнику, так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: “Ось народиться син домові Давида, Йосія — його імʼя; і він принесе в жертву на тобі священників пагірків, які кадять на тобі, і людські кістки спалять на тобі”».
uk.B: За словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} він закликав проти жертовника: «Жертовнику, жертовнику! Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: “У домі Давида народиться син, і його імʼя буде Йосія. Він принесе в жертву на тобі священників узвиш, які тут палять своє кадило, і на тобі спалять людські кістки”».
uk.R: За наказом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} він закричав до жертовника: «Жертовнику, жертовнику! Ось що говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: “Колись у родині Давида народиться син на імʼя Йосія. Він убʼє священників святилищ на узвишшях, які палять на тобі кадило, і принесе їх на тобі в жертву. На тобі спалять людські кістки”».

decisions.choice: Josiah: the king of Judah who carried this out (2 Kings 23:15-18)
decisions.reason: About three hundred years later Josiah king of Judah tore down the altar at Bethel. He took bones from the tombs there and burned them on the altar to make it unclean, and he left alone the tomb of the man of God who had foretold it (2 Kings 23:15-18). On the altars of the towns of Samaria he killed the priests of the high places (2 Kings 23:20). Naming a king generations before his birth is rare in Scripture; compare Cyrus in Isaiah 44:28-45:1.

decisions.choice: Altar, altar: the prophecy is spoken to the altar itself
decisions.reason: He does not speak to the king but to the altar, calling it twice for weight. The altar Jeroboam had made stands for the worship he had set up (12:28-33).

decisions.choice: sacrificing priests and burning bones on the altar: making it unclean for ever
decisions.reason: A dead body made anything it touched unclean (Numbers 19:11-16). Killing the priests on their own altar and burning human bones there would defile the altar so that it could never be used again.

decisions.choice: the house of David: the royal family of Judah
decisions.reason: Jeroboam had led the northern tribes away from David's family (12:16-20) and feared they would go back to it (12:26-27). The prophecy says a king from that same family will one day judge this altar.

decisions.choice: the man of God's words in double quotation marks, the LORD's words inside them in single marks
decisions.reason: The man of God speaks, and what he speaks is the LORD's message. Literal says "thus says the LORD", Balanced "The LORD says this" and Readable "This is what the LORD says", as throughout Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: kill the priests ... and offer them on you as sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "sacrifice the priests" means: they will be killed on the altar like animals offered there.

decisions.choice: "Josías"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form, also Matthew 1:10-11 in the published Spanish.

decisions.choice: the man of God’s words in « », the LORD’s words inside them in “ ”
decisions.reason: French quotation marks follow the style guide: « » for the speech, “ ” for the message quoted inside it.

decisions.choice: the prophet's words in double quotation marks, the LORD's in single
decisions.reason: As the English, the man of God's speech is in double marks and the words of the LORD he reports are in single marks inside it.

decisions.choice: "Giô-si-a"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for Josiah, the same in 2 Kings 22-23.

decisions.choice: the oracle spoken to the altar in 해라체 ("제단아")
alternatives: 합쇼체 to the king who stands by it
decisions.reason: The man of God addresses the altar, not Jeroboam, so the vocative "-아" and 해라체 fit; he speaks to the king in 합쇼체 when the king addresses him (verse 8).

decisions.choice: Assim diz o SENHOR (L, B); É isto que o SENHOR diz (R)
alternatives: Isto é o que o SENHOR diz
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the messenger formula keeps one wording at each level, "Assim diz o SENHOR" at Literal and Balanced, the familiar form of 2 Samuel 12:7 in Portuguese, and "É isto que o SENHOR diz" at Readable. The LORD speaks to the altar with "ti" (m2), as God addresses one hearer with "tu".

decisions.choice: Josias
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the king of 2 Kings 22-23 (m1) is named in the form Brazilian readers know, "Josias".

decisions.choice: "ኢዮስያስ" (Josiah); the altar is spoken to with "አንተ"
decisions.reason: Josiah as the terms list names him; an altar addressed as a thing takes the plain singular.

decisions.choice: The altar is addressed with "तू" ("तुझ पर")
decisions.reason: The prophecy is spoken to the altar itself (meaning m2); Hindi speaks to a thing with "तू", which also suits a curse.

decisions.choice: "योशिय्याह"
decisions.reason: As the history-books note and Matthew 1:10.

decisions.choice: Double marks for the man of God, single marks for the LORD's words inside
decisions.reason: As the English, so that each level opens and closes the same quotations.

decisions.choice: "Иосия"
decisions.reason: As Matthew 1:10-11 in this translation and the history terms note.

decisions.choice: « » for the man of God, “ ” for the LORD's words inside
decisions.reason: The Russian marks follow the English levels of quotation, as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: mizbeach mizbeach "祭壇よ、祭壇よ" addressed as おまえ; Josiah "ヨシヤ" (MAT 1:10)
decisions.reason: The prophecy is spoken to the altar itself, so the altar is "おまえ" (as the mountains addressed in 2SA 1:21); Josiah in the NT form.

decisions.choice: L and B keep the Hebrew's two clauses (he will sacrifice ... and human bones will be burned) with a change of subject
decisions.reason: The English L "they will burn" is impersonal; Japanese gives it as a passive (焼かれる), as the English B.

source.text: וְנָתַן֩ בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֤וּא מוֹפֵת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֣ה הַמּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ נִקְרָ֔ע וְנִשְׁפַּ֖ךְ הַדֶּ֥שֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gave on that day a sign, saying, This [is] the sign that spoke Yahweh: look, the altar [will be] torn apart, and poured out the fat-ash which [is] on it.

en.L: And he gave a sign on that day, saying, "This [is] the sign that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken: look, the altar will be torn apart, and the ash that [is] on it will be poured out."
en.B: That same day he gave a sign: "This is the sign that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken: The altar will be split apart, and the ashes on it will be poured out."
en.R: That same day the man of God also gave a sign to show that his message was true. He said, "This is the sign {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given: This altar will split apart, and the ashes on it will spill out."

es.L: Y dio aquel día una señal, diciendo: «Esta [es] la señal de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado: he aquí que el altar se partirá, y se derramará la ceniza que [está] sobre él».
es.B: Ese mismo día dio una señal: «Esta es la señal que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha anunciado: el altar se partirá, y la ceniza que tiene encima se derramará».
es.R: Ese mismo día, el hombre de Dios dio también una señal para mostrar que su mensaje era verdadero. Dijo: «Esta es la señal que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dado: este altar se partirá, y la ceniza que tiene encima se derramará».

fr.L: Et il donna un signe ce jour-là, en disant : « Voici le signe dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé : voici, l’autel va se fendre, et la cendre qui [est] dessus sera répandue. »
fr.B: Le même jour, il donna un signe : « Voici le signe que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a annoncé : l’autel va se fendre, et la cendre qui est dessus sera répandue. »
fr.R: Le même jour, l’homme de Dieu a aussi donné un signe pour montrer que son message était vrai. Il a dit : « Voici le signe que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné : cet autel va se fendre, et la cendre qui est dessus va se répandre. »

sw.L: Akatoa ishara siku ile, akisema, "Hii [ndiyo] ishara ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema: tazama, madhabahu itapasuka, na majivu yaliyo juu yake yatamwagika."
sw.B: Siku ile ile akatoa ishara: "Hii ndiyo ishara ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema: Madhabahu itapasuka, na majivu yaliyo juu yake yatamwagika."
sw.R: Siku hiyo hiyo mtu wa Mungu akatoa pia ishara ili kuonyesha kwamba ujumbe wake ulikuwa wa kweli. Akasema, "Hii ndiyo ishara ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametoa: Madhabahu hii itapasuka, na majivu yaliyo juu yake yatamwagika."

vi.L: Ngày ấy ông ban một dấu lạ, rằng: "Đây [là] dấu lạ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: Kìa, bàn thờ sẽ bị nứt ra, và tro ở trên đó sẽ đổ ra."
vi.B: Cũng ngày ấy, ông ban một dấu lạ: "Đây là dấu lạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: Bàn thờ sẽ nứt ra, và tro trên bàn thờ sẽ đổ xuống."
vi.R: Cũng ngày ấy, người của Đức Chúa Trời còn đưa ra một dấu lạ để chứng tỏ sứ điệp của ông là thật. Ông nói: "Đây là dấu lạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban: Bàn thờ này sẽ nứt ra, và tro trên đó sẽ đổ xuống."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그날 표적을 주며 말했다. "이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 표적이다. 보아라, 제단이 갈라지고 그 위에 있는 재가 쏟아질 것이다."
ko.B: 그날 그는 표적도 주었다. "이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 표적이다. 제단이 갈라지고 그 위의 재가 쏟아질 것이다."
ko.R: 그날 하나님의 사람은 자기 말이 참이라는 것을 보여 주려고 표적도 주었다. 그가 말했다. "이것이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 표적이다. 이 제단이 갈라지고 그 위의 재가 쏟아질 것이다."

pt.L: E ele deu um sinal naquele dia, dizendo: "Este [é] o sinal de que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou: eis que o altar será fendido, e a cinza que [está] sobre ele será derramada."
pt.B: Naquele mesmo dia ele deu um sinal: "Este é o sinal que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} anunciou: o altar se partirá, e as cinzas que estão sobre ele serão derramadas."
pt.R: Naquele mesmo dia o homem de Deus também deu um sinal para mostrar que a sua mensagem era verdadeira. Ele disse: "Este é o sinal que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu: este altar vai se partir, e as cinzas que estão sobre ele vão se espalhar no chão."

am.L: በዚያም ቀን ምልክት ሰጠ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተናገረው ምልክት ይህ [ነው]፤ እነሆ፣ መሠዊያው ይሰነጠቃል፤ በላዩም ያለው አመድ ይፈስሳል።»
am.B: በዚያው ቀን እንዲህ ብሎ ምልክት ሰጠ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተናገረው ምልክት ይህ ነው፤ መሠዊያው ይሰነጠቃል፤ በላዩ ያለውም አመድ ይፈስሳል።»
am.R: በዚያው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰው መልእክቱ እውነት መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ምልክት ደግሞ ሰጠ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሰጠው ምልክት ይህ ነው፦ ይህ መሠዊያ ይሰነጠቃል፤ በላዩ ያለውም አመድ ይፈስሳል።»

hi.L: और उसने उसी दिन एक चिह्न देकर कहा, "यह वह चिह्न [है] जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है: देखो, वेदी फट जाएगी, और उस पर की राख गिर जाएगी।"
hi.B: उसी दिन उसने एक चिह्न भी दिया: "यह वह चिह्न है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है: वेदी फट जाएगी, और उस पर की राख बिखर जाएगी।"
hi.R: उसी दिन परमेश्वर के उस जन ने एक चिह्न भी दिया, ताकि पता चले कि उसका संदेश सच्चा है। उसने कहा, "यह वह चिह्न है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दिया है: यह वेदी फट जाएगी, और उस पर की राख बिखर जाएगी।"

ru.L: И дал он в тот день знамение, говоря: «Вот знамение, о котором сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: вот, жертвенник распадётся, и высыплется пепел, который на нём.»
ru.B: В тот же день он дал знамение: «Вот знамение, о котором сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: жертвенник расколется, и пепел на нём высыплется.»
ru.R: В тот же день человек Божий дал знак, чтобы показать, что его весть правдива. Он сказал: «Вот знак, который дал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: этот жертвенник расколется, и пепел с него рассыплется.»

ja.L: そして彼はその日、しるしを与えて言った。「これが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が告げられたしるしである。いいか、祭壇は裂け、その上の灰はこぼれ出る。」
ja.B: その同じ日に、彼はしるしを示した。「これが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の告げられたしるしである。祭壇は裂け、その上の灰はこぼれ出る。」
ja.R: その同じ日に、神の人は、自分の言葉が本当であることを示すしるしも与えました。神の人は言いました。「これが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えられたしるしである。この祭壇は裂けて、その上の灰がこぼれ出る。」

uk.L: І дав він того дня знак, кажучи: «Це [той] знак, про який говорив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: ось жертовник розколеться, і висиплеться попіл, що [є] на ньому».
uk.B: Того ж дня він дав знак: «Ось знак, про який сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: жертовник розколеться, і попіл, що на ньому, висиплеться».
uk.R: Того ж дня чоловік Божий дав також знак, щоб показати, що його послання правдиве. Він сказав: «Ось знак, який дав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: цей жертовник розколеться, і попіл, що на ньому, висиплеться».

decisions.choice: sign: a wonder that proves a message true
decisions.reason: The word is used of wonders that show a messenger is sent by God (Exodus 7:9; Deuteronomy 13:2). The far-off prophecy about Josiah is backed by a sign that happens at once (verse 5).

decisions.choice: the ash: the fat-soaked ashes of the offerings
decisions.reason: The word means ashes mixed with the fat of burnt sacrifices, which were removed carefully to a clean place (Leviticus 1:16; 6:3-4). Spilled on the ground, they show the altar's offerings rejected.

decisions.choice: he gave: the man of God gave the sign
decisions.reason: The subject carries on from verse 2. The sign is part of what he announced that day.

decisions.choice: the man of God ... to show that his message was true
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker and says what a sign is for.

decisions.choice: "la ceniza"
decisions.reason: The word means the ashes soaked with the fat of the offerings; Spanish "ceniza" says enough in the sentence, as the English "ash" does.

decisions.choice: majivu
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the fat-soaked ash of the offerings; "majivu" is enough in Swahili, and the meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: "dấu lạ" for the sign
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for a sign that proves a message true; "phép lạ" (miracle) is avoided.

decisions.choice: "표적" at every level
decisions.reason: "표적" is the Korean Bible word for a sign that proves a message true, as in John; "기적" would name only the wonder.

decisions.choice: a cinza (L); as cinzas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The fat-soaked ash of the offerings (m2) is "cinza" in the singular at Literal, as the Hebrew, and "as cinzas" at Balanced and Readable, the ordinary Portuguese plural for what is left on an altar, as Leviticus 1:16 and 6:3-4 have it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "አመድ" (the ash) for the fat-soaked ashes
decisions.reason: The word of the Amharic Exodus 27:3 and Leviticus for the ash of the offerings.

decisions.choice: "चिह्न"
decisions.reason: A wonder that proves a message true (meaning m1); "चिह्न" as in John in this translation, not "चमत्कार".

decisions.choice: "राख"
decisions.reason: The fat-soaked ashes of the offerings (meaning m2); plain "राख" at every level, as the English says ashes.

decisions.choice: "знамение" (L, B); "знак" (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for John: "знамение" for a sign that proves a message true (m1), "знак" at Readable, never "чудо".

decisions.choice: "пепел"
decisions.reason: The fat-soaked ashes of the offerings (m2); "пепел" says it plainly.

decisions.choice: mofet "しるし" (every level); deshen "灰" (every level)
decisions.reason: A wonder that proves the message true; the fat-soaked ashes of the offerings.

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בְּבֵֽית־אֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת־יָד֛וֹ מֵעַ֥ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֵאמֹ֣ר׀תִּפְשֻׂ֑הוּ וַתִּיבַ֤שׁ יָדוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֣ח עָלָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לַהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when heard the king the word of the man of God which he called out against the altar in Bethel, and stretched out Jeroboam his hand from on the altar, saying, Seize him; and dried up his hand which he stretched out against him, and not he was able to bring it back to himself.

en.L: And it happened, when the king heard the word of the man of God that he called out against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, "Seize him!" And his hand that he stretched out against him dried up, and he was not able to draw it back to himself.
en.B: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God had cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he had stretched out against him withered, so that he could not pull it back.
en.R: King Jeroboam heard what the man of God had shouted against the altar at Bethel. He stretched out his hand from the altar toward the man and said, "Grab him!" But the king's hand shriveled up, and he could not pull it back.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando el rey oyó la palabra del hombre de Dios que había clamado contra el altar en Betel, Jeroboam extendió su mano desde el altar, diciendo: «¡{{plural_you:Préndanlo|Prendedlo}}!». Y se le secó la mano que había extendido contra él, y no pudo volverla hacia sí.
es.B: Cuando el rey Jeroboam oyó lo que el hombre de Dios había clamado contra el altar de Betel, extendió su mano desde el altar y dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Préndanlo|Prendedlo}}!». Pero la mano que había extendido contra él se le quedó seca, y no pudo retirarla.
es.R: El rey Jeroboam oyó lo que el hombre de Dios había gritado contra el altar de Betel. Extendió la mano desde el altar hacia el hombre y dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Agárrenlo|Agarradlo}}!». Pero la mano del rey se le quedó seca, y no pudo retirarla.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand le roi entendit la parole de l’homme de Dieu qu’il avait criée contre l’autel à Béthel, que Jéroboam étendit sa main de dessus l’autel en disant : « Saisissez-le ! » Et sa main qu’il avait étendue contre lui se dessécha, et il ne put la ramener à lui.
fr.B: Quand le roi Jéroboam entendit ce que l’homme de Dieu avait crié contre l’autel de Béthel, il étendit la main depuis l’autel et dit : « Arrêtez-le ! » Mais la main qu’il avait étendue contre lui se dessécha, et il ne put la ramener à lui.
fr.R: Le roi Jéroboam a entendu ce que l’homme de Dieu avait crié contre l’autel de Béthel. Il a tendu la main depuis l’autel vers lui et il a dit : « Attrapez-le ! » Mais la main du roi s’est desséchée, et il ne pouvait plus la ramener vers lui.

sw.L: Ikawa, mfalme aliposikia neno la mtu wa Mungu alilolilia dhidi ya madhabahu huko Betheli, Yeroboamu akanyosha mkono wake kutoka madhabahuni, akisema, "Mkamateni!" Mkono wake aliounyosha dhidi yake ukakauka, wala hakuweza kuurudisha kwake.
sw.B: Mfalme Yeroboamu aliposikia maneno ambayo mtu wa Mungu aliyapaza dhidi ya madhabahu huko Betheli, alinyosha mkono wake kutoka madhabahuni, akasema, "Mkamateni!" Lakini mkono aliounyosha dhidi yake ukanyauka, hata hakuweza kuurudisha.
sw.R: Mfalme Yeroboamu alisikia maneno ambayo mtu wa Mungu aliyapigia kelele dhidi ya madhabahu huko Betheli. Akanyosha mkono wake kutoka madhabahuni kumwelekea yule mtu, akasema, "Mkamateni!" Lakini mkono wa mfalme ukanyauka, wala hakuweza kuurudisha.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi vua nghe lời người của Đức Chúa Trời đã kêu nghịch cùng bàn thờ tại Bê-tên, thì Giê-rô-bô-am giơ tay ra từ bàn thờ mà nói: "Hãy bắt lấy hắn!" Nhưng bàn tay ông đã giơ ra nghịch cùng người ấy liền khô lại, và ông không thể rút về được.
vi.B: Khi vua Giê-rô-bô-am nghe lời người của Đức Chúa Trời kêu nghịch cùng bàn thờ tại Bê-tên, vua giơ tay ra từ bàn thờ và nói: "Bắt lấy hắn!" Nhưng bàn tay vua giơ ra chỉ người ấy liền khô cứng lại, không thể co về được.
vi.R: Vua Giê-rô-bô-am nghe điều người của Đức Chúa Trời kêu lên nghịch cùng bàn thờ tại Bê-tên. Vua giơ tay từ bàn thờ chỉ về phía người ấy và ra lệnh: "Bắt lấy hắn!" Nhưng bàn tay vua liền teo lại, và vua không thể rút tay về được.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 벧엘에 있는 제단을 향해 외친 하나님의 사람의 말을 들었을 때, 여로보암이 제단에서 그의 손을 뻗으며 말했다. "그를 잡아라!" 그러자 그를 향해 뻗은 그의 손이 말라 버려서, 그는 그것을 자기에게로 되돌릴 수 없었다.
ko.B: 여로보암 왕은 하나님의 사람이 벧엘에 있는 제단을 향해 외친 말을 듣고, 제단에서 손을 뻗으며 말했다. "저자를 잡아라!" 그러나 그를 향해 뻗은 손이 말라 버려서, 왕은 손을 다시 거두어들일 수 없었다.
ko.R: 여로보암 왕은 하나님의 사람이 벧엘의 제단을 향해 외친 말을 들었다. 그는 제단에서 그 사람 쪽으로 손을 뻗으며 말했다. "저 사람을 붙잡아라!" 그러나 왕의 손이 오그라들어서 다시 거둘 수 없었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando o rei ouviu a palavra do homem de Deus que ele clamou contra o altar em Betel, Jeroboão estendeu a sua mão de cima do altar, dizendo: "Prendam-no!" E a sua mão, que ele estendeu contra ele, secou, e ele não pôde trazê-la de volta para si.
pt.B: Quando o rei Jeroboão ouviu o que o homem de Deus tinha clamado contra o altar de Betel, estendeu a mão do altar e disse: "Prendam-no!" Mas a mão que ele tinha estendido contra o homem ficou seca, e ele não conseguiu recolhê-la.
pt.R: O rei Jeroboão ouviu o que o homem de Deus tinha gritado contra o altar de Betel. Ele estendeu a mão do altar na direção do homem e disse: "Agarrem esse homem!" Mas a mão do rei ficou paralisada e seca, e ele não conseguiu puxá-la de volta.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ንጉሡ በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ የጮኸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮርብዓም፦ «ያዙት» ብሎ እጁን ከመሠዊያው ላይ ዘረጋ። በእርሱም ላይ የዘረጋት እጁ ደረቀች፤ ወደ ራሱም ሊመልሳት አልቻለም።
am.B: ንጉሡ ኢዮርብዓም የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ የጮኸውን በሰማ ጊዜ፣ እጁን ከመሠዊያው ዘርግቶ፦ «ያዙት!» አለ። ነገር ግን በእርሱ ላይ የዘረጋት እጁ ደረቀች፤ መልሶም ሊሰበስባት አልቻለም።
am.R: ንጉሡ ኢዮርብዓም የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ የጮኸውን ሰማ። እጁንም ከመሠዊያው ወደ ሰውየው ዘርግቶ፦ «ያዙት!» አለ። ነገር ግን የንጉሡ እጅ ደርቃ ቀረች፤ ሊመልሳትም አልቻለም።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब राजा ने परमेश्वर के जन का वह वचन सुना जो उसने बेतेल की वेदी के विरुद्ध पुकारकर कहा था, तब यारोबाम ने वेदी पर से अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर कहा, "उसे पकड़ लो!" और उसका वह हाथ जो उसने उसकी ओर बढ़ाया था सूख गया, और वह उसे अपनी ओर फिर खींच न सका।
hi.B: जब राजा यारोबाम ने वह बात सुनी जो परमेश्वर के जन ने बेतेल की वेदी के विरुद्ध पुकारकर कही थी, तब उसने वेदी के पास से अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर कहा, "उसे पकड़ लो!" पर जो हाथ उसने उसकी ओर बढ़ाया था, वह सूख गया, यहाँ तक कि वह उसे वापस न खींच सका।
hi.R: राजा यारोबाम ने सुना कि परमेश्वर के जन ने बेतेल की वेदी के विरुद्ध क्या कहा है। उसने वेदी के पास से उस पुरुष की ओर हाथ बढ़ाकर कहा, "पकड़ो इसे!" पर राजा का हाथ सूखकर अकड़ गया, और वह उसे वापस न खींच सका।

ru.L: И было, когда услышал царь слово человека Божьего, которое он воскликнул против жертвенника в Вефиле, Иеровоам простёр свою руку от жертвенника, говоря: «Схватите его!» И иссохла его рука, которую он простёр на него, и он не мог вернуть её к себе.
ru.B: Когда царь Иеровоам услышал, что человек Божий прокричал против жертвенника в Вефиле, он простёр от жертвенника руку и сказал: «Схватите его!» Но рука, которую он простёр против него, отсохла, так что он не мог вернуть её назад.
ru.R: Царь Иеровоам услышал, что человек Божий прокричал против жертвенника в Вефиле. Он протянул от жертвенника руку к этому человеку и сказал: «Хватайте его!» Но рука царя высохла, и он не мог согнуть её обратно.

ja.L: そして、王が、ベテルの祭壇に向かって呼ばわった神の人の言葉を聞いたとき、ヤロブアムは祭壇の上から手を伸ばして言った。「彼を捕らえよ！」すると、彼に向かって伸ばした彼の手はなえて、それを自分のほうに引き戻すことができなくなった。
ja.B: ヤロブアム王は、神の人がベテルの祭壇に向かって叫んだ言葉を聞くと、祭壇から手を伸ばして、「あの男を捕らえよ！」と言った。すると、彼に向けて伸ばした手がなえてしまい、引き戻すことができなくなった。
ja.R: ヤロブアム王は、神の人がベテルの祭壇に向かって叫んだことを聞きました。王は、祭壇のところから神の人のほうに手を伸ばして、「あいつを捕まえろ！」と言いました。ところが、王の手はかたまってしまい、元に戻すことができなくなりました。

uk.L: І сталося, коли почув цар слово чоловіка Божого, яке він закликав проти жертовника в Бетелі, то Єровоам простягнув свою руку від жертовника, кажучи: «Схопіть його!» І всохла його рука, яку він простягнув проти нього, і не міг він повернути її до себе.
uk.B: Коли цар Єровоам почув, що чоловік Божий прокричав проти жертовника в Бетелі, він простягнув свою руку від жертовника і сказав: «Схопіть його!» Але рука, яку він простягнув проти нього, всохла, так що він не міг її повернути.
uk.R: Цар Єровоам почув, що чоловік Божий прокричав проти жертовника в Бетелі. Він простягнув руку від жертовника в його бік і сказав: «Хапайте його!» Але цареві рука всохла, і він не міг її опустити.

decisions.choice: dried up: became stiff and useless
decisions.reason: The verb is used of grass and plants drying out. Here the king's arm became rigid and could not move, so he could not draw it back.

decisions.choice: the hand raised against God's messenger is struck
decisions.reason: The king stretches out his hand as a command to arrest the man of God, and that hand is the one that fails. Yahweh protects the one who speaks his word.

decisions.choice: from the altar: from where he stood beside it
decisions.reason: Jeroboam was standing at the altar (verse 1), probably on its raised platform, and gave the order from there.

decisions.choice: King Jeroboam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the king" first and names Jeroboam later in the sentence. Balanced and Readable join the two at the start.

decisions.choice: ukanyauka
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ukakauka" (dried up); Balanced and Readable say "ukanyauka" (withered), the word Swahili uses of a limb that becomes stiff and useless.

decisions.choice: ficou seca (B); ficou paralisada e seca (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of plants drying out, and here it means that the arm became stiff and useless (m1). "Secar" keeps the picture at every level, as Portuguese says of a limb that has lost its life; Readable adds "paralisada" so that the reader sees why he could not pull it back.

decisions.choice: "सूख गया" (L, B); "सूखकर अकड़ गया" (R)
decisions.reason: The hand became stiff and useless (meaning m1); Readable adds the stiffness, as the English says shriveled up.

decisions.choice: "иссохла" (L); "отсохла" (B); "высохла" (R)
decisions.reason: The hand became stiff and useless (m1); each level keeps the image of drying.

decisions.choice: The king's order rough (捕らえよ / 捕まえろ)
decisions.reason: An angry royal order, as Saul's orders in 1SA 22 (rough at every level).

decisions.choice: yavash "なえて" (L, B), "かたまってしまい" (R)
decisions.reason: The hand became stiff and useless; Readable uses an everyday word, as the English R "shriveled up".

source.text: וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ נִקְרָ֔ע וַיִּשָּׁפֵ֥ךְ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן מִן־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כַּמּוֹפֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the altar was torn apart, and poured out was the fat-ash from the altar, according to the sign which gave the man of God by [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And the altar was torn apart, and the ash was poured out from the altar, according to the sign that the man of God had given by [the] word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The altar was split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, in keeping with the sign that the man of God, by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, had given.
en.R: Then the altar split apart, and the ashes spilled out of it. This was the sign the man of God had given at {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s command.

es.L: Y el altar se partió, y se derramó la ceniza del altar, conforme a la señal que el hombre de Dios había dado por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El altar se partió, y la ceniza se derramó del altar, conforme a la señal que el hombre de Dios había dado por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces el altar se partió, y la ceniza se derramó. Esa era la señal que el hombre de Dios había dado por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et l’autel se fendit, et la cendre fut répandue de l’autel, selon le signe que l’homme de Dieu avait donné par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: L’autel se fendit, et la cendre se répandit hors de l’autel, conformément au signe que l’homme de Dieu avait donné par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors l’autel s’est fendu, et la cendre s’est répandue par terre. C’était le signe que l’homme de Dieu avait donné sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Madhabahu ikapasuka, na majivu yakamwagika kutoka madhabahuni, sawasawa na ishara aliyoitoa mtu wa Mungu kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Madhabahu ikapasuka, na majivu yakamwagika kutoka madhabahuni, sawasawa na ishara ambayo mtu wa Mungu aliitoa kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ndipo madhabahu ikapasuka, na majivu yakamwagika kutoka ndani yake. Hii ndiyo ishara ambayo mtu wa Mungu alikuwa ametoa kwa amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Bàn thờ bị nứt ra, và tro từ bàn thờ đổ ra, đúng theo dấu lạ mà người của Đức Chúa Trời đã ban theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Bàn thờ nứt ra, và tro từ bàn thờ đổ xuống, đúng như dấu lạ người của Đức Chúa Trời đã ban theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ bàn thờ nứt ra, và tro trên đó đổ xuống. Đó chính là dấu lạ mà người của Đức Chúa Trời đã báo trước theo lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 제단이 갈라지고, 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 준 표적대로 재가 제단에서 쏟아졌다.
ko.B: 그리고 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 준 표적대로, 제단이 갈라지고 재가 제단에서 쏟아졌다.
ko.R: 그때 제단이 갈라지고 재가 쏟아졌다. 이것은 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 받고 말한 바로 그 표적이었다.

pt.L: E o altar foi fendido, e a cinza foi derramada do altar, segundo o sinal que o homem de Deus tinha dado pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: O altar se partiu, e as cinzas se derramaram do altar, como dizia o sinal que o homem de Deus, pela palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tinha dado.
pt.R: Então o altar se partiu, e as cinzas se espalharam no chão. Esse era o sinal que o homem de Deus tinha dado por ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ቃል እንደ ሰጠው ምልክት መሠዊያው ተሰነጠቀ፤ አመዱም ከመሠዊያው ፈሰሰ።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል እንዳዘዘው በሰጠው ምልክት መሠረት መሠዊያው ተሰነጠቀ፤ አመዱም ከመሠዊያው ፈሰሰ።
am.R: ከዚያም መሠዊያው ተሰነጠቀ፤ አመዱም ከእርሱ ፈሰሰ። ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ሰው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘው የሰጠው ምልክት ነበር።

hi.L: और वेदी फट गई, और वेदी पर से राख गिर गई, उस चिह्न के अनुसार जो परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से दिया था।
hi.B: वेदी फट गई और उस पर की राख बिखर गई, ठीक उस चिह्न के अनुसार जो परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन से दिया था।
hi.R: तब वेदी फट गई और उसकी राख बिखर गई। यह वही चिह्न था जो परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की आज्ञा से दिया था।

ru.L: И жертвенник распался, и высыпался пепел с жертвенника, по знамению, которое дал человек Божий по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Жертвенник раскололся, и пепел высыпался с жертвенника, как и было в знамении, которое человек Божий дал по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Тогда жертвенник раскололся, и пепел с него рассыпался. Это и был тот знак, который человек Божий дал по повелению {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして、神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によって与えたしるしのとおりに、祭壇は裂け、灰は祭壇からこぼれ出た。
ja.B: そして、神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉によって示したしるしのとおり、祭壇は裂け、灰は祭壇からこぼれ出た。
ja.R: すると、祭壇が裂けて、灰がこぼれ出ました。それは、神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に命じられて告げたしるしのとおりでした。

uk.L: І жертовник розколовся, і висипався попіл із жертовника, за знаком, який дав чоловік Божий за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Жертовник розколовся, і попіл висипався з жертовника, саме за тим знаком, який чоловік Божий дав за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тоді жертовник розколовся, і попіл висипався з нього. Це був той знак, який чоловік Божий дав за наказом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the altar split: the sign happened at once
decisions.reason: The narrator reports the sign coming true straight away, while the king stands there with his hand stiff. It may have happened in the same moment as verse 4.

decisions.choice: the sign fulfilled confirms the word
decisions.reason: A prophet whose word comes true is shown to be sent by Yahweh (Deuteronomy 18:21-22). The split altar is a pledge that the prophecy about Josiah will also come true.

decisions.choice: This was the sign ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the last phrase a sentence of its own.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀אֶל־אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים חַל־נָ֞א אֶת־פְּנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדִ֔י וְתָשֹׁ֥ב יָדִ֖י אֵלָ֑י וַיְחַ֤ל אִישׁ־הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתָּ֤שָׁב יַד־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵלָ֔יו וַתְּהִ֖י כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered the king and said to the man of God, Soften please [the] face of Yahweh your God and pray for me, and may return my hand to me. And softened the man of God [the] face of Yahweh, and returned [the] hand of the king to him, and it was as at the first.

en.L: And the king answered and said to the man of God, "Please soften the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and pray for me, so that my hand may come back to me." And the man of God softened the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the king's hand came back to him and was as [it was] at the first.
en.B: Then the king said to the man of God, "Please plead with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and pray for me, so that my hand may be restored to me." So the man of God pleaded with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the king's hand was restored to him and became as it was before.
en.R: Then the king said to the man of God, "Please beg {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God to be kind to me, and pray for me, so that my hand will be healed." So the man of God begged {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the king's hand was healed. It was just as it had been before.

es.L: Y respondió el rey y dijo al hombre de Dios: «Aplaca, por favor, el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, y ora por mí, para que mi mano vuelva a mí». Y el hombre de Dios aplacó el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y la mano del rey volvió a él y quedó como [estaba] al principio.
es.B: Entonces el rey le dijo al hombre de Dios: «Por favor, suplica {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios y ora por mí, para que mi mano me sea restaurada». El hombre de Dios suplicó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y la mano del rey le fue restaurada y quedó como antes.
es.R: Entonces el rey le dijo al hombre de Dios: «Por favor, ruégale {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios que tenga compasión de mí, y ora por mí, para que mi mano se sane». El hombre de Dios le rogó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y la mano del rey se sanó. Quedó tal como estaba antes.

fr.L: Et le roi répondit et dit à l’homme de Dieu : « Adoucis, je te prie, la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et prie pour moi, et que ma main revienne à moi. » Et l’homme de Dieu adoucit la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la main du roi revint à lui et fut comme au commencement.
fr.B: Le roi dit alors à l’homme de Dieu : « Implore, je te prie, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu et prie pour moi, afin que ma main me soit rendue. » L’homme de Dieu implora {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et la main du roi lui fut rendue ; elle redevint comme avant.
fr.R: Alors le roi a dit à l’homme de Dieu : « S’il te plaît, supplie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu d’être bon pour moi, et prie pour moi, pour que ma main soit guérie. » L’homme de Dieu a supplié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et la main du roi a été guérie. Elle est redevenue comme avant.

sw.L: Mfalme akajibu, akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Tafadhali, ulainishe uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, uniombee, ili mkono wangu urudi kwangu." Mtu wa Mungu akaulainisha uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mkono wa mfalme ukarudi kwake, ukawa kama [ulivyokuwa] mwanzo.
sw.B: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Tafadhali, msihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako na kuniombea, ili mkono wangu urudishwe kwangu." Basi mtu wa Mungu akamsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mkono wa mfalme ukarudishwa kwake, ukawa kama ulivyokuwa mwanzo.
sw.R: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Tafadhali mwombe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anihurumie, uniombee ili mkono wangu upone." Basi mtu wa Mungu akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na mkono wa mfalme ukapona. Ukawa kama ulivyokuwa hapo awali.

vi.L: Vua đáp lời và nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Xin ông làm dịu mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông và cầu nguyện cho ta, để tay ta được trở lại cho ta." Người của Đức Chúa Trời làm dịu mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tay vua trở lại với vua và được như lúc trước.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Xin ông nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông và cầu nguyện cho ta, để tay ta được lành lại." Vậy người của Đức Chúa Trời nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tay vua được lành lại như trước.
vi.R: Vua nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Xin ông nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông thương xót ta, và cầu nguyện cho ta, để tay ta được lành." Vậy người của Đức Chúa Trời nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tay vua được lành lại, giống hệt như trước.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 대답하여 하나님의 사람에게 말했다. "부디 그대의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴을 누그러뜨리고 나를 위해 기도하여, 내 손이 내게 돌아오게 해 주시오." 그러자 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴을 누그러뜨렸고, 왕의 손이 그에게 돌아와 처음과 같이 되었다.
ko.B: 그러자 왕이 하나님의 사람에게 말했다. "그대의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 은혜를 구하고 나를 위해 기도하여, 내 손이 회복되게 해 주시오." 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 간구하자, 왕의 손이 회복되어 전과 같이 되었다.
ko.R: 그러자 왕이 하나님의 사람에게 말했다. "그대의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 나에게 자비를 베풀어 달라고 간청해 주시오. 나를 위해 기도해서 내 손이 낫게 해 주시오." 그래서 하나님의 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 간청하자 왕의 손이 나았다. 손이 전과 똑같이 되었다.

pt.L: E o rei respondeu e disse ao homem de Deus: "Por favor, abrande a face {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus, e ore por mim, para que a minha mão volte para mim." E o homem de Deus abrandou a face {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e a mão do rei voltou para ele e ficou como [era] no princípio.
pt.B: Então o rei disse ao homem de Deus: "Por favor, suplique {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, e ore por mim, para que a minha mão seja restaurada." Então o homem de Deus suplicou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e a mão do rei foi restaurada e ficou como era antes.
pt.R: Então o rei disse ao homem de Deus: "Por favor, peça {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, que tenha bondade de mim. Ore por mim, para que a minha mão fique curada." Então o homem de Deus suplicou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e a mão do rei ficou curada. Ficou exatamente como era antes.

am.L: ንጉሡም መልሶ የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው እንዲህ አለው፦ «እባክህ የአምላክህን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ፊት አለዝብ፤ እጄም ወደ እኔ እንድትመለስ ስለ እኔ ጸልይ።» የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ፊት አለዘበ፤ የንጉሡም እጅ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፤ እንደ ቀድሞውም ሆነች።
am.B: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው፦ «እባክህ አምላክህን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለምንልኝ፤ እጄም እንድትመለስልኝ ስለ እኔ ጸልይ» አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለመነ፤ የንጉሡም እጅ ተመለሰችለት፤ እንደ ቀድሞውም ሆነች።
am.R: ከዚያም ንጉሡ የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው፦ «እባክህ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምሕረት እንዲያደርግልኝ ለምንልኝ፤ እጄም እንድትፈወስ ጸልይልኝ» አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለመነ፤ የንጉሡም እጅ ተፈወሰች። እንደ ቀድሞውም ሆነች።

hi.L: और राजा ने परमेश्वर के जन से उत्तर देकर कहा, "कृपा करके {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के मुख को मनाइए, और मेरे लिए प्रार्थना कीजिए, कि मेरा हाथ मेरी ओर लौट आए।" और परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुख को मनाया, और राजा का हाथ उसकी ओर लौट आया, और पहले के समान [हो गया]।
hi.B: तब राजा ने परमेश्वर के जन से कहा, "कृपा करके {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से विनती कीजिए और मेरे लिए प्रार्थना कीजिए कि मेरा हाथ फिर ठीक हो जाए।" तब परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से विनती की, और राजा का हाथ ठीक होकर पहले जैसा हो गया।
hi.R: तब राजा ने परमेश्वर के जन से कहा, "कृपा करके {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर से विनती कीजिए कि वे मुझ पर दया करें, और मेरे लिए प्रार्थना कीजिए, ताकि मेरा हाथ ठीक हो जाए।" तब परमेश्वर के जन ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से विनती की, और राजा का हाथ ठीक हो गया। वह ठीक वैसा ही हो गया जैसा पहले था।

ru.L: И ответил царь и сказал человеку Божьему: «Умилостиви, прошу, лицо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, и помолись за меня, чтобы вернулась ко мне моя рука.» И умилостивил человек Божий лицо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и вернулась к царю его рука и стала как прежде.
ru.B: Тогда царь сказал человеку Божьему: «Прошу тебя, умоли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, и помолись за меня, чтобы моя рука вернулась ко мне.» И человек Божий умолил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и рука вернулась к царю и стала такой, как прежде.
ru.R: Тогда царь сказал человеку Божьему: «Прошу тебя, попроси {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, твоего Бога, смилостивиться надо мной и помолись за меня, чтобы моя рука исцелилась.» Человек Божий попросил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и рука царя исцелилась. Она стала такой же, как прежде.

ja.L: そして王は答えて、神の人に言った。「どうか、あなたの神{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の御顔を和らげ、わたしのために祈ってください。わたしの手が元に戻るように。」そこで神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の御顔を和らげると、王の手は彼のもとに戻り、初めのようになった。
ja.B: 王は神の人に言った。「どうか、あなたの神{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に願い求めて、わたしのために祈ってください。わたしの手が元どおりになるように。」そこで神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に願い求めると、王の手は元どおりになり、前と同じようになった。
ja.R: 王は神の人に言いました。「どうか、あなたの神{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に、わたしをあわれんでくださるようにお願いしてください。わたしのために祈って、わたしの手を治していただいてください。」そこで神の人が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にお願いすると、王の手は治って、前と同じようになりました。

uk.L: І відповів цар, і сказав чоловікові Божому: «Умилостиви, прошу, обличчя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, і помолися за мене, щоб повернулася до мене моя рука». І умилостивив чоловік Божий обличчя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і повернулася цареві його рука, і стала як спершу.
uk.B: Тоді цар сказав чоловікові Божому: «Благай, прошу, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, і помолися за мене, щоб моя рука одужала». Чоловік Божий поблагав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і цареві рука одужала і стала така, як раніше.
uk.R: Тоді цар сказав чоловікові Божому: «Прошу, попроси {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, твого Бога, бути милостивим до мене, і помолися за мене, щоб моя рука одужала». Тож чоловік Божий попросив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і цареві рука одужала. Вона стала така, як була раніше.

decisions.choice: soften the face of the LORD: plead with Yahweh for favor
decisions.reason: The idiom pictures making someone's face pleasant toward you. It is used of earnest prayer that turns away anger (Exodus 32:11; 2 Kings 13:4).

decisions.choice: your God: the king speaks of the LORD as the prophet's God
decisions.reason: Jeroboam asks the man of God to pray to "your God". The wording sets the king at a distance from the God whose altar law he has broken.

decisions.choice: the man of God prays for the king, and the hand is healed
decisions.reason: The one the king tried to seize now prays for him, and Yahweh hears. The healing shows that the power to strike and to restore lies with Yahweh and his word.

decisions.choice: beg the LORD your God to be kind to me; healed
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of the face and says "healed" for the hand coming back.

decisions.choice: "aplaca el rostro del SEÑOR" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of softening God's face; "aplacar" is the Spanish verb that carries it naturally. Balanced and Readable say "suplicar" and "rogar", as the English says "plead" and "beg".

decisions.choice: "adoucis la face du SEIGNEUR" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of softening someone’s face, which French can follow; Balanced says "implore", Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: ulainishe uso wa BWANA
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture "soften the face" with "kulainisha uso"; Balanced and Readable say "kumsihi" and "kumwomba ... anihurumie".

decisions.choice: the king says "ông" to the man of God and "ta" for himself
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for these books, the king speaks to a prophet as "ông"; the prophet calls the king "vua" and himself "tôi" (verse 8).

decisions.choice: "làm dịu mặt CHÚA" (L); "nài xin" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of softening the LORD's face; Balanced and Readable say what it means, pleading for favour.

decisions.choice: the king speaks to the man of God in 하오체 with "그대"
decisions.reason: As David speaks to Nathan and Gad in the Korean Samuel, a king addresses a prophet with 하오체: above him in rank, yet with respect. The prophets answer kings in 합쇼체, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "얼굴을 누그러뜨리다" at Literal; "은혜를 구하다", "간구하다" (B), "간청하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of softening the LORD's face; Balanced and Readable say what it means, to plead for his favor.

decisions.choice: você (the king and the man of God to each other)
decisions.reason: The king speaks to the man of God with "você" ("o seu Deus", "ore"), as a king speaks to a subject, and the man of God answers the king with "você", with the authority of a prophet, as Gad and Nathan speak to David in 2 Samuel in Portuguese. "O seu Deus" keeps the distance the king puts between himself and the LORD (m2).

decisions.choice: the king says "አንተ" to the man of God and the man of God "አንተ" to the king (verses 6-9)
decisions.reason: A king speaks down with the plain form; a prophet bringing God's word to a king says "አንተ", as the terms list sets.

decisions.choice: "ፊት አለዝብ" (soften the face)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say "ለምን" (plead).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुख को मनाइए" (L); "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से विनती कीजिए" (B, R)
decisions.reason: To soften the face of the LORD is to plead with Yahweh for favor (meaning m1); Literal keeps the picture, Balanced and Readable say the sense.

decisions.choice: "умилостиви лицо ГОСПОДА" (L); "умоли ГОСПОДА" (B); "попроси ГОСПОДА смилостивиться надо мной" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image of softening the face; the other levels say "plead for favour" (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ты" between the king and the man of God
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel in Russian, "ты" between a king and a prophet; the courtly tone is carried by "прошу".

decisions.choice: chal-na et penei YHWH "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の御顔を和らげ" (L), "…に願い求めて" (B), "…にあわれんでくださるようにお願いして" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom as 1SA 13:12 (1SA-2: 御顔を和らげる L), the sense "plead for favor" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: The king, now humbled, to the man of God です・ます (どうか…ください)
decisions.reason: His tone turns from a rough order (13:4) to a plea; the man of God is not named and speaks plainly as God's messenger.

decisions.choice: "умилостиви обличчя ГОСПОДА" at L, keeping the Hebrew image as the English Literal does
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "soften the face"; the other levels say what it means, an earnest plea.

records.literal_gloss: And spoke the king to the man of God, Come with me home, and refresh yourself, and I will give to you a gift.

en.L: And the king spoke to the man of God, "Come with me to the house and refresh yourself, and I will give you a gift."
en.B: Then the king said to the man of God, "Come to the palace with me and have something to eat, and I will give you a gift."
en.R: The king told the man of God, "Come to my house with me and eat something. I will give you a present."

es.L: Y el rey dijo al hombre de Dios: «Ven conmigo a la casa y repón fuerzas, y te daré un regalo».
es.B: Entonces el rey le dijo al hombre de Dios: «Ven conmigo al palacio y come algo, y te daré un regalo».
es.R: El rey le dijo al hombre de Dios: «Ven conmigo a mi casa y come algo. Te daré un regalo».

fr.L: Et le roi parla à l’homme de Dieu : « Viens avec moi à la maison et restaure-toi, et je te donnerai un présent. »
fr.B: Le roi dit à l’homme de Dieu : « Viens avec moi au palais pour manger quelque chose, et je te ferai un présent. »
fr.R: Le roi a dit à l’homme de Dieu : « Viens chez moi avec moi et mange quelque chose. Je te donnerai un cadeau. »

sw.L: Mfalme akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Njoo pamoja nami nyumbani, ujiburudishe, nami nitakupa zawadi."

sw.R: Mfalme akamwambia mtu wa Mungu, "Njoo nyumbani kwangu pamoja nami ule kitu. Nitakupa zawadi."

vi.L: Vua nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Hãy cùng ta về nhà và bồi bổ sức lực, rồi ta sẽ ban cho ông một món quà."

vi.R: Vua nói với người của Đức Chúa Trời: "Hãy cùng ta về nhà và ăn chút gì. Ta sẽ tặng ông một món quà."

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 하나님의 사람에게 말했다. "나와 함께 집으로 가서 기운을 차리시오. 내가 그대에게 선물을 주겠소."

ru.B: Потом царь сказал человеку Божьему: «Пойдём со мной во дворец, поешь, и я дам тебе подарок.»

uk.L: І говорив цар до чоловіка Божого: «Ходи зі мною додому й підкріпися, і я дам тобі дарунок».
uk.B: Тоді цар сказав чоловікові Божому: «Ходи зі мною до палацу і поїж чогось, а я дам тобі дарунок».
uk.R: Цар сказав чоловікові Божому: «Ходи зі мною до мого дому і поїж чогось. Я дам тобі подарунок».

decisions.choice: refresh yourself: take food to restore your strength
decisions.reason: The verb means to support or sustain, and with food it means a meal that gives strength (Genesis 18:5; Judges 19:5).

decisions.choice: a meal and a gift from the king: a sign of fellowship and favor
decisions.reason: Gifts to prophets were common (1 Samuel 9:7-8; 2 Kings 5:15-16). To eat at the king's table and take his gift would bind the man of God to the king and seem to approve his altar.

decisions.choice: have something to eat
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "refresh yourself" means here.

decisions.choice: "अपने को तरोताज़ा कीजिए" (L); "कुछ भोजन कीजिए" (B); "कुछ खा लीजिए" (R)
decisions.reason: To refresh yourself is to take food (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: The king's invitation in the plain style of a king (〜なさい, 〜しよう)
decisions.reason: Once the hand is healed, the king speaks again as a king, kindly but from above; the plea of 13:6 was the polite moment.

en.L: And the man of God said to the king, "If you give me half your house, I will not go with you, and I will not eat bread and I will not drink water in this place.
en.B: But the man of God answered the king, "Even if you gave me half your palace, I would not go in with you, and I will not eat bread or drink water in this place.
